method.method_draft: Model the rectangle with coordinates. From the image, set J = (0, h), K = (0, 0), L = (w, 0), and M = (w, h), with w > h. From the text, Tess starts at J and runs counterclockwise at constant speed around the sides. On side JK, her distance from J is simply the vertical distance traveled, so it rises linearly from 0 to h. On side KL, her position is (x, 0), so the distance to J is sqrt(x^2 + h^2), increasing from h to sqrt(w^2 + h^2). On side LM, her position is (w, y), so the distance to J is sqrt(w^2 + (h - y)^2), decreasing from the diagonal to w. On side MJ, her distance is the horizontal separation from J, so it decreases linearly from w to 0. Therefore the graph has four consecutive pieces: increasing, still increasing to a maximum, decreasing but staying above zero, then decreasing to zero; the candidate graph with this structure is image5.
